page: Microsoft Azure DC2es_v5 is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine belonging to the DCEV5 server family. This instance is configured with 2 dedicated virtual CPUs powered by an Intel processor and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU.

The DC2es_v5 instance does not include local storage, but it is designated as Premium Storage capable, allowing the attachment of external persistent storage volumes. It does not come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses, and there is no integrated GPU hardware on this server type.

Positioned within the memory-optimized DCEV5 family, this entry-level 2-vCPU configuration provides a dedicated compute allocation suitable for lightweight database workloads, small-scale web serving, or general-purpose application hosting requiring dedicated CPU resources. Its qualitative cost profile reflects a low-resource entry point within its hardware class, balancing dedicated processing cores with a moderate memory footprint.
